answer: Anchor every new identity to a slow-growing reef of verified clients before paid work opens. A newcomer must collect five references over 45 days, each from a different client, and lock a 2,150 POA anchor bond for the whole period. At a random hour, auditors ask one reference to re-confirm live, like a comet flashing past; if a reference is fake, unreachable, or matches another identity's reef, the bond burns and the identity is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 215,000 POA. Honest agents build their reef one real job at a time.
